programs.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Becoming Bionic"
programs.desc: From dissecting stolen corpses and peering into microscopes, the secret structure of the brain and nervous system is exposed. Could this lead to a race of superhumans?

programs.desc: Host Steve Spangler presents amazing science stunts that your friends will not believe – but they’re real! – from pre-sliced bananas to the way to crush raw eggs without turning them to mushy egg soup.

programs.desc: Steve Spangler creates science toys, tricks and experiments that you can make using simple things you can find in your kitchen.

programs.desc: One group of fourth grade students faces “The DIY SCI Challenge.” Steve Spangler challenges them to invent a contraption that will keep an egg from breaking when it’s dropped from a ladder.

programs.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Recycled Science"
programs.desc: Steve Spangler shows you how to take your recycled junk and turn it into the coolest do-it-yourself science.

programs.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Science on Fire"
programs.desc: This week's experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.
